raw.title: Principal Technical Product Owner - DoiT Partner Platform
raw.excerpt: LocationOur Principal Technical Product Owner - DoiT PartnerOps will be an integral part of our Product Management team.
raw.description:
LocationOur Principal Technical Product Owner - DoiT PartnerOps will be an integral part of our Product Management team. This role is based remotely in the East US, Canada, the UK or Ireland.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity
We’re hiring a Principal Technical Product Owner to drive the strategy, rapid delivery, and iteration for the DoiT Partner Platform. This platform enables cloud partners, resellers, and service providers to operate, monetize, and scale their cloud businesses across major hyperscalers. The platform is designed to help partners manage the operational and financial complexity of the cloud ecosystem, including cloud billing, margin management, customer lifecycle workflows, and partner-led service delivery.

This senior role is built for a leader with a "technical founder" mindset. You will act as the tip of the spear for all DoiT Partner Platform initiatives, serving as a leader amongst the product team to guide the broader product vision and set the standard for execution. You will bring relentless curiosity about how the cloud ecosystem works, a deep understanding of hyperscaler partner programs, and the confidence to test ideas directly with domain experts. The right leader will have held hands-on roles within the cloud ecosystem—such as cloud operations, cloud billing / FinOps, or partner operations—and will bring direct experience working with channel business models. In addition to hands-on execution, you will help direct strategy, align cross-functional teams, and mentor other technical product owners across the organization.

Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Delivery

  • Act as the "tip of the spear" for the DoiT Partner Platform: Serve as the foremost product authority and a leader amongst peers, driving alignment across multiple product squads and setting the bar for product excellence.
  • Own the overarching strategy, delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for major platform components.
  • Partner with VP-level leadership to define strategic direction, translating it into clear problems to solve and shippable scope.
  • Direct and mentor other Technical Product Owners to elevate product management practices, ensuring cohesive execution across the entire platform portfolio.
  • Drive the feedback loop across teams: discover → define → build → release → measure → iterate, repeatedly.
  • Review technical designs, reason about complex tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer.

Deep Partner & Ecosystem Understanding

  • Leverage your hands-on experience within the cloud ecosystem and understanding of channel, reseller, and partner business models.
  • Develop deep empathy for the workflows of cloud partners: billing operations, margin management, reseller customer management, support operations, and service delivery.
  • Use direct partner conversations and operational insight to identify friction, gaps, and strategic opportunities to improve how partners run their cloud businesses.

Cloud Billing & Partner Operations Expertise

  • Bring strong understanding of cloud billing constructs, marketplace programs, margin models, and partner incentives across hyperscalers.
  • Help shape complex platform capabilities that manage or abstract complexity in areas such as:
    • Multi-cloud billing aggregation.
    • Partner margin and discount models.
    • Customer invoicing and revenue operations.
    • Usage and cost transparency.
    • Marketplace and private offer workflows.

Executive & Partner Validation

  • Speak frequently with key partners (aiming for 3–5 conversations a week) and internal stakeholders to validate ideas, refine workflows, and test assumptions.
  • Engage deeply with executive stakeholders at cloud partners, MSPs, SIs, and resellers to understand how they operate their cloud businesses.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into strategic decisions, and explain "why" in a way that builds trust and consensus among peers and leadership.

Engineering-Embedded Technical Product Ownership

  • Operate as a core leader working closely with Engineering leaders—present in daily collaboration, crisp in decision-making, and pragmatic about constraints.
  • Partner with Engineering leads on sequencing, technical tradeoffs, and delivery planning—ensuring product intent survives implementation realities.
  • Ensure components are cohesive across UX, APIs, data, and operational behavior, supporting partner-grade reliability and scalability.

Quality, Outcomes, Trust & Governance

  • Define what “success” means for the platform portfolio with clear metrics (partner adoption, onboarding speed, billing accuracy, workflow completion, retention, reliability signals, partner-reported impact).
  • Instrument learning: ensure releases are measurable and that insights reliably flow back into portfolio prioritization.
  • Ensure platform capabilities account for the operational realities of the cloud partner ecosystem, including billing accuracy, financial reconciliation, and auditability.

Qualifications

  • Extensive product leadership experience with 10+ years of direct experience in the cloud ecosystem, ideally across roles such as cloud operations, FinOps, partner operations, or building platforms that serve cloud customers or partners.
  • Proven ability to act as a "player-coach"—driving high-level strategy, executing hands-on alongside engineering, and directing/mentoring other product owners as a respected peer leader.
  • Strong experience with cloud billing systems, cost and usage data, or revenue operations within cloud environments.
  • Deep understanding of the cloud partner ecosystem (resellers, MSPs, SIs, distributors, marketplaces). Candidates have likely worked within the partner ecosystem at some point in their careers.
  • Experience building or operating platforms that serve channel or partner-driven business models.
  • Strong product sense for turning messy operational problems into clear scope and shipped value with an excellent user experience.
  • Technical fluency in cloud fundamentals and APIs across AWS, Google Cloud, and/or Azure.
  • Coding experience is a plus—enough to collaborate effectively with engineers, reason about feasibility, and understand system behaviors.
  • Must have demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate product specifications and development.
  • Excellent communication skills: ability to engage deeply with partners, cloud experts, and internal stakeholders at the executive level.
  • A bias for action and continuous improvement: you ship, measure, learn, and iterate.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • You are universally recognized by your peers and leadership as the driving force and primary authority ("tip of the spear") for the Partner Platform's product direction.
  • Platform capabilities ship frequently with clear partner value.
  • Partner feedback loops are strong and visibly influence the overarching roadmap.
  • Adoption across the partner ecosystem increases and partner operational workflows improve measurably.
  • Billing accuracy, financial transparency, and operational scalability improve for partners using the platform.
  • Engineering teams consistently have clarity on the next most valuable increment to build—and why.
  • Other product owners on the team are effectively mentored, aligned, and elevated through your leadership.

Are you a Do’er?Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do’ers, One TeamDoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

We are looking for a Frontend Engineer (React) to join the Binance BigPay team. You will build intuitive, secure, and high-performance payment experiences used by customers globally. Working closely with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will deliver scalable web applications while solving complex engineering challenges in a fast-paced fintech environment.

This is a 100% remote, work-from-home opportunity.

Responsibilities

  • Build high-performance, scalable, and user-centric web applications using React and TypeScript.
  • Develop intuitive payment experiences for both desktop and mobile web platforms.
  • Design reusable UI components and contribute to shared frontend libraries to improve engineering efficiency and maintainability.
  • Collaborate closely with backend engineers, product managers, designers, and QA to deliver high-quality product features.
  • Optimize application performance through modern frontend techniques such as code splitting, lazy loading, caching, and rendering optimization.
  • Drive engineering best practices including code quality, testing, accessibility, and frontend architecture.
  • Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and contribute to the evolution of the frontend platform.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience building production web applications.
  • Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Hands-on experience with modern React ecosystems such as React Query, Redux, or similar state management solutions.
  • Experience building scalable, maintainable, and reusable UI component libraries or design systems.
  • Solid understanding of frontend performance optimization, responsive design, and browser rendering.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working closely with backend services.
  • Familiarity with modern frontend tooling such as Next.js, Vite, Webpack, Tailwind CSS, or equivalent.
  • Strong engineering mindset with attention to code quality, maintainability, and user experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualification

    • Experience building financial technology, payment, or transaction-based products.
    • Experience developing large-scale consumer-facing applications with high availability and performance requirements.
    • Experience with AI-powered user experiences, intelligent workflows, or LLM-integrated frontend applications.
    • Familiarity with frontend testing frameworks such as Jest, Playwright, or Cypress.
    • Experience contributing to design systems or shared component libraries.
    • Passion for fintech, digital payments, and creating exceptional user experiences.

Why Binance

• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)
Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC) $60K-$85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Chattanooga, TN

Salary:

60K - 85K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With two convenient locations in Colorado and growing, OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and work-site location(s). Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available location. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) in the state of Colorado with the ability to practice independently is required.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $60,000 – $85,000 / year

Lumicera Health Services is seeking a Specialist, Workforce Management to join our team!

The Specialist, Workforce Management is responsible for supporting workforce management setup, scheduling, analysis, forecasting, etc. to ensure internal and external service levels commitments are achieved. The WFM Specialist performs basic troubleshooting with the workforce management systems including input and output systems and escalates as necessary. This position will review available data or requests new reports to make recommendations on staffing to consistently meet service levels and run and requests enhancements to analytic reports on a regular and ad-hoc basis that assist in identifying areas of performance improvement, providing recommendations for efficiencies, and projecting staffing for future volume.

Is this you? Find out more below!

How do I make an impact on my team?

raw.description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $62,000 – $80,000 / year

Systems Reliability Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Systems Reliability Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer to ensure the availability, performance, and operational excellence of large-scale distributed systems in production. As an SRE you will live at the boundary between development and operations, applying strong software engineering principles to infrastructure and operations problems, and continually pushing the platform toward higher reliability with lower operational toil. The ideal candidate will combine deep systems knowledge with strong programming skills, a measurement-driven mindset, and the discipline to design, automate, and operate complex services so that reliability becomes a first-class engineering deliverable rather than a reactive concern.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define, instrument, and continually refine service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and error budgets for critical services, and use those measures to drive concrete engineering and prioritization decisions.
  • Lead incident response and resolution for production issues, acting as a calm and effective incident commander when needed, and ensuring high-quality post-incident reviews that drive lasting improvements.
  • Design and implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing strategies using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, Datadog, or similar tooling so that operators have rich, actionable visibility into system behavior.
  • Build and maintain robust on-call processes, runbooks, and escalation paths that reduce mean time to detect and mean time to resolve while protecting the well-being of the engineers on rotation.
  • Automate operational toil aggressively by writing production-grade tooling in Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages, replacing manual workflows with reliable, auditable automation.
  • Architect and operate large-scale Kubernetes clusters and container-based workloads, including autoscaling, capacity planning, network policy, and integration with service meshes.
  • Design CI/CD pipelines that promote safe, frequent, and observable releases, supported by automated testing, canary deployments, feature flags, and progressive rollout strategies.
  • Lead capacity planning and performance engineering activities, building models that predict growth and stress, and validating those models through load testing and chaos experiments.
  • Partner closely with application development teams to embed reliability practices early in design — including failure-mode analyses, graceful degradation patterns, and dependency hardening.
  • Strengthen the platform’s resiliency through chaos engineering, fault injection, dependency isolation, retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, and well-tested failover paths.
  • Drive continuous improvement of security posture in collaboration with security teams, including patch management, vulnerability remediation, and secure-by-default platform defaults.
  • Contribute to the technical roadmap for reliability tooling, observability platforms, and developer-experience improvements that reduce friction and improve outcomes for engineering teams.
  • Mentor engineers across the organization on SRE practices and foster a strong, blameless culture of operational excellence.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SRE, DevOps, or production engineering experience supporting large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one of Python, Go, or Java, with the ability to build robust automation and tooling.
  • Deep, hands-on experience operating Linux at scale, including networking, performance tuning, and systems-level troubleshooting.
  • Production experience operating Kubernetes and container-based workloads.
  • Strong working knowledge of observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, or commercial equivalents.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for both infrastructure and applications.
  • Solid understanding of distributed system design, including consistency models, partitioning, and failure semantics.
  • Demonstrated experience leading incident response and conducting effective post-incident reviews.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience defining and operationalizing SLOs and error budgets in real production environments.
  • Exposure to chaos engineering practices and tools such as Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, or Litmus.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Background in capacity planning, performance engineering, or large-scale load testing.
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio, Linkerd, or Consul.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to boon@bvteck.com or contact us at (908) 650-6699. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

About Dreem Health, by Sunrise

Dreem Health is America’s leading digital sleep clinic. Powered by Sunrise’s technology, Dreem Health makes sleep care simple — replacing long waits and in-lab sleep studies with home-based testing, expert telehealth visits, and personalized treatment plans that are easy for patients to follow. We’re fixing the broken sleep care journey and helping more people get the care they need — from home, on their schedule.

Your Opportunity

We're looking for a Patient Experience Coordinator to join the Patient Experience team at Dreem Health. In this role, you'll help patients navigate their sleep care journey by providing responsive first-line support, managing patient communications across phone, email, text messaging, and in-app messaging, addressing a wide range of non-clinical patient inquiries, and collaborating with Care Coordination and Billing, and other cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless patient experience.

This is a high-impact role reporting directly to the Customer Succes Manager. You'll play an important role in helping patients stay informed, engaged, and supported by delivering timely communication, resolving non-clinical questions and requests, coordinating cross-functional handoffs when needed, and supporting operational workflows that contribute to an exceptional patient experience.

If you're passionate about patient care, thrive in a dynamic setting, are organized, proactive, patient-focused, and motivated by measurable outcomes, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how sleep care is delivered at scale.

At Sunrise Group, we work on a problem that affects millions: poor sleep and untreated sleep disorders. Our mission is to make diagnosis and care easier to access, and we’re proud of the experience we provide to patients. We feel responsible for making it better every day. If you’re looking for the autonomy to take ownership of your work, make an impact, and be part of a team where ideas move fast and everyone has a voice - this role is for you!

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for patients through phone, email, and in-app messaging.
  • Work within a tech-enabled, AI-supported care environment
  • Partner with Care Coordination, Billing, Clinical Operations, and other cross-functional teams to ensure patients receive coordinated support throughout their care journey.
  • Resolve a broad range of non-clinical patient inquiries while delivering a positive, patient-centered experience.
  • Escalate clinical, billing, or patient access concerns to the appropriate teams when additional expertise is required.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and ensure all patient interactions are recorded in accordance with established workflows and HIPAA requirements.
  • Communicate clearly and compassionately with patients
  • Prioritize multiple patient conversations while meeting service level expectations in a dynamic environment.
  • Recognize recurring patient concerns and emerging trends, bringing opportunities for process improvement to the Customer Success Manager
  • Contribute to operational initiatives that improve patient satisfaction, communication quality, and organizational performance.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in healthcare coordination, patient support, care navigation, customer success, or another patient-facing healthcare role.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a high level of empathy, professionalism, and emotional intelligence.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic, remote environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Confidence using digital communication tools, healthcare technology, and patient engagement platforms.
  • Data driven mindset with the ability to track tasks, maintain accurate records, and follow structured workflows
  • Genuine commitment to improving patient experience
  • Operational and automation mindset
  • Availability to work Pacific Time or Eastern Time (PST or EST) business hours

Our Core Values

At Sunrise Group, we keep things clear and simple ✨, value trust and collaboration 🤝, and lead with optimism and compassion 🌞. These values guide everything we do.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful work that directly improves peoples’ lives
  • Be part of an international team across the US, France, Belgium
  • Annual team offsite
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • FREE One Medical membership
  • 401(k) with company match
  • 20 days PTO + 10 paid holidays + 80 hours paid sick leave
  • Internet stipend

Compensation

$23 - $25 depending on experience.

We hire humans, not bullet points. Don’t meet every single qualification? That’s okay. We care more about who you are than what’s on your CV. We’re looking for people who are curious, resourceful, and ready to roll up their sleeves — especially if you’re excited about building something new in healthcare. So if you think you could make an impact here, reach out to us.

Compensation Range - Depending on Experience
$23—$25 USD

raw.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $62,000 – $80,000 / year

Please apply here:https://form.typeform.com/to/EThi0ZmR

At Skinnify, we make clothing with built-in resistance — leggings, sleeves, shoes, and more — that turn everyday movements like walking, cooking, or commuting into a passive workout. In just three years, we've grown from 0 to 150,000+ customers — and we're just getting started.

To get a better idea of our company and what it's like to work on our team, check out this short video:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Imn7tqGmLXZxcpNBRI0mxYA6ayPwLT7j/view?usp=sharing

Now, we're looking for a full-time Creative Strategist (40 hours/week) to lead our creative efforts and develop scroll-stopping video and image ads that drive conversions, build our brand, and scale our growth.

Tasks

🔹 Your Responsibilities

✅ Develop high-converting ad concepts, creative angles, hooks, and storylines for video and image ads

✅ Research competitors, customer psychology, and market trends to uncover winning creative opportunities

✅ Manage our team of 3 full-time video editors and 1 full-time image designer

✅ Work closely with media buyers and the growth team to launch creative tests, analyze performance, and continuously iterate

✅ Own and optimize the entire creative pipeline to consistently deliver world-class performance creatives

Requirements

🎯 What We're Looking For

✔️ Creative Vision – You naturally think outside the box and understand what captures attention and drives purchases

✔️ Performance Marketing Experience – You've developed high-performing ad creatives for DTC ecommerce brands (fitness or fashion experience is a major plus)

✔️ Creative Execution – You know how to take an idea from initial concept to a polished, high-converting final asset

✔️ UGC & Creator Management – You know where to find talented creators and how to brief them to produce exceptional content

✔️ Data-Driven Mindset – You care about results, constantly testing and improving creative based on performance metrics

✔️ Organized & Independent – You can manage multiple projects, creators, and deadlines while taking full ownership of your work

✔️ Fluent English (Written & Spoken) – Strong communication is essential in our fully remote team

Benefits

💡 Why Join Skinnify?

📈 Join a Hyper-Growth Brand – From 0 to 150,000+ customers in 3 years. Your ideas will directly influence our growth and revenue.

🚀 Real Career Growth – Your trajectory here is whatever you make of it. One team member went from video editor to creative strategist and doubled their salary. Another started in customer support and now runs the entire customer support team. We promote from within and invest in people who want to grow.

💼 Full Flexibility – Work from anywhere, anytime. We run on trust and results, not time tracking — as long as the work gets done, your hours are yours.

🧠 Learning Budget – Courses, books, consulting calls — we cover it. Many team members book calls with founders of major ecommerce brands and experienced operators through platforms like and .

✈️ Two Company Retreats a Year, Fully Paid – We rent a house in a new country each time, explore together, and actually get to know one another. Here's a video from our latest company retreat:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nOLkLRGauSxiJYMli4WxU36wJ5Z7aUe6/view?usp=sharing

⭐ Loved by the Team – Rated 5 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor

🏋️‍♀️ The Skinnify Story

Our founder Christian grew up in Frankfurt, Germany. Looking around, he noticed something striking: so many of the women in his life — his mom, his sister, his friends — wanted to get fitter, lose weight, and build muscle, but kept running into the same wall. They didn't have the time, the motivation, or the consistency to make the gym work.

The idea hit him during his own workout. He was using resistance bands and thought: what if these were built into everyday clothing? What if women could get the benefits of resistance training passively — while walking the kids to school, cooking dinner, or sitting at their desk? Fitness without the extra time or effort.

The idea was personal too. Christian was a difficult kid growing up and put his mom through a lot. She barely had time for herself, let alone the gym. He built Skinnify for women like her: busy, hardworking, often overlooked — so they could do something good for their bodies just by getting dressed.

🛍️ Our Products

What started with a single product — leggings with built-in resistance bands — has grown into a full collection of resistance-integrated clothing: leggings, sleeves, shoes, and more. We're on a mission to revolutionize how women do fitness by turning daily life into a workout.

🌟 Skinnify's Core Values

💡 Innovation – We design groundbreaking clothing with built-in resistance to revolutionize fitness.

🔥 Effectiveness – Our products help people burn more calories and get fitter with every step.

🌍 Accessibility – We make fitness accessible to everyone — even the busiest and least motivated.

🎉 Fun – We make exercise feel effortless and enjoyable.

✅ Quality – Our products are built to last — high-quality, durable, and reliable.

Ready to build the next generation of winning ecommerce ads and shape the creative direction of one of the fastest-growing fitness brands?

Who We Are

Pattern Data is an AI-powered platform built for the complexities of mass tort litigation. We help leading law firms automate case analysis, accelerate settlement decisions, and manage high-volume inventories that were traditionally manual and time-intensive.

The problems we work on are complex and high-stakes, requiring precision, adaptability, and a deep understanding of both data and client needs.

We’re a collaborative, high-ownership team that moves quickly and takes pride in solving hard problems well. People at Pattern go deep to understand the “why,” build solutions that hold up, and stay focused on what drives real outcomes for our customers. We value transparency, thoughtful problem-solving, and authenticity in how we work together and we’re looking for someone who’s excited to contribute to a team that’s actively building and improving every day.

What You’ll Do

As an Account Executive at Pattern Data, you will own the full sales cycle – from prospecting to close – with law firms of varying sizes, focusing on building sustainable, high-value client relationships. You’ll be responsible for developing a healthy pipeline, leading consultative sales conversations, and delivering tailored solutions that help firms scale their operations through Pattern’s technology.

  • Target new prospects and manage your own book of business, focusing on both mid-market and enterprise mass tort law firms.
  • Prospect, qualify, and lead discovery calls and demos to uncover client needs and propose data-driven solutions.
  • Strategize and implement creative approaches when faced with client challenges that defy easy fixes.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, decision-makers, and industry partners to support revenue goals.
  • Create account plans to maximize opportunities within existing and prospective clients, ensuring a recurring and sustainable book of business.
  • Structure and manage negotiations to successfully close deals and build long-term client partnerships.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Client Success, and Engineering to advocate for client needs, shape feature development, and deliver customized solutions that maximize product adoption and value.
  • Represent Pattern at industry conferences, client meetings, and networking events to strengthen market presence and generate new opportunities.
  • Travel up to 30% for client meetings, on-site visits, and industry events.
  • Effectively manage time, prioritize competing objectives, and consistently exceed goals in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Bring

  • BA/BS degree preferred.
  • 3-6 years of quota-carrying software or technology sales and account management experience.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding annual quotas and closing deals with large ACVs (e.g., $50,000-$200,000 in size).
  • Experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation, with a demonstrated ability to manage full-cycle consultative sales.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all decision-making levels.
  • Comfort navigating complex client environments with multiple stakeholders and decision-makers.

raw.excerpt: **PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ** Location: Remote — Latin America (LATAM) Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
raw.description:
**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH **

Location: Remote — Latin America (LATAM)

Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

Employment Type: Full-Time (Contractor)

Number of Openings: 1 Position

Industry: Creative Agency / Branding / Marketing & Design

English Proficiency: Advanced (C1/C2) – Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

Schedule: Full-Time | US Central Time, approximately 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM CT

Start Date: As Soon As Possible

About the Company

This opportunity is with a U.S.-based creative agency specializing in premium branding, visual identity, social media, digital experiences, and content creation for lifestyle, hospitality, fashion, design, luxury, and consumer brands.

The agency partners with a diverse portfolio of clients to build visually powerful, strategically thoughtful, and timeless brand experiences. Its work spans branding, websites, social media, and digital content, with a strong focus on creating high-end editorial visuals that feel distinctive and aligned with each brand’s identity.

The company operates with a small, collaborative, and highly creative team. Its culture values strong taste, attention to detail, speed, accountability, and the ability to consistently produce polished work without sacrificing quality.

About the Role

We are looking for a talented Brand Content Creator & Video Editor who can transform raw footage, creative direction, and brand guidelines into compelling visual content for social media and digital platforms.

The primary focus of this role is video editing. You will be responsible for reviewing large footage libraries, identifying the strongest moments, editing short-form vertical videos, improving color and sound, and adding motion graphics where they enhance the final piece.

You will work across multiple brands simultaneously, ensuring that every piece of content remains visually consistent with the unique identity, tone, and style of each client.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who enjoys working quickly, receiving direct creative feedback, and producing a high volume of polished brand content. The ideal candidate is not looking to redefine the creative direction of each brand, but rather to understand it, extend it, and bring it to life through video.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Join a growing U.S.-based creative agency working with premium brands across multiple industries.

  • Collaborate directly with experienced creative leaders and designers.

  • Build a strong portfolio of professional social media and branded content.

  • Work across a variety of visual styles, industries, and brand identities.

  • Strengthen your skills in storytelling, editing, color, sound design, and motion graphics.

  • Gain exposure to modern creative-production workflows and AI-powered tools.

  • Contribute meaningfully to a small, collaborative, and design-driven team.

What You’ll Do

  • Edit short-form vertical videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other digital platforms.

  • Review and organize large footage libraries to identify the strongest clips and moments.

  • Transform raw footage into polished, engaging, and brand-aligned visual content.

  • Edit English-language talking-head videos with strong pacing, rhythm, and storytelling.

  • Perform professional color correction and color grading to improve depth, mood, and visual consistency.

  • Add motion graphics, kinetic typography, animated logos, transitions, and branded visual elements where appropriate.

  • Select and edit music, sound effects, and audio elements that match each brand’s identity.

  • Manage multiple client projects and brand styles simultaneously.

  • Follow creative direction provided through Loom, Slack, live calls, and project briefs.

  • Respond to feedback quickly and revise content efficiently.

  • Deliver files through Frame.io using clear naming conventions and version control.

  • Collaborate with designers and creative leadership to ensure video content fits within larger brand systems.

  • Use AI-powered creative tools to improve efficiency and expand production capabilities.

  • Participate in daily team calls and maintain consistent communication throughout the workday.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate has a strong visual eye, excellent editing instincts, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced creative environment.

You are comfortable balancing multiple projects, adapting to different brand identities, and receiving direct feedback. You understand that the goal is not simply to create trendy content, but to create content that feels authentic, visually compelling, and unmistakably aligned with each brand.

You are highly organized, collaborative, detail-oriented, and capable of managing your time independently while staying connected with the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional video editing experience.

  • Strong portfolio or reel showcasing real branded social media content.

  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro.

  • Solid proficiency in Adobe After Effects.

  • Strong experience editing short-form vertical content for social media.

  • Experience editing real footage, including lifestyle, product, location, or talking-head content.

  • Strong understanding of pacing, visual rhythm, storytelling, music, and sound design.

  • Experience with professional color correction and color grading.

  • Ability to create motion graphics, kinetic typography, transitions, and animated brand elements.

  • Advanced English proficiency, C1 or C2, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to edit English-language talking-head content accurately and naturally.

  • Experience managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

  • Ability to work efficiently, accept feedback, and complete revisions without unnecessary delays.

  • Experience using remote collaboration and project-management tools such as Slack, Loom, Frame.io, Notion, Google Workspace, or similar platforms.

  • Reliable high-speed internet connection.

  • Personal computer capable of handling professional editing workflows, 4K footage, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and AI tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with a creative agency, branding studio, production company, or marketing agency.

  • Experience editing content for lifestyle, hospitality, fashion, luxury, architecture, design, or consumer brands.

  • Experience producing high-volume social media content across multiple brands.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools such as Runway, Sora, ElevenLabs, Topaz, or similar platforms.

  • Experience using Figma.

  • Basic knowledge of Blender or 3D workflows.

  • Experience creating motion assets for websites, including Lottie animations, hero-section motion, or other digital experiences.

  • Understanding of premium editorial design and timeless visual aesthetics.

How Success Is Measured

  • Consistently delivering high-quality content at a strong production pace.

  • Producing work that is approved and published without requiring excessive revisions.

  • Accurately translating creative direction into finished content.

  • Demonstrating strong pacing, sound selection, color, and visual consistency.

  • Maintaining each brand’s identity while working across multiple projects.

  • Managing feedback, revisions, files, and deadlines effectively.

  • Contributing positively to a collaborative and fast-moving creative environment.

  • Using tools, technology, and AI to improve efficiency without lowering the quality of the final work.

Why Join Us

  • Work with a collaborative, design-driven team that values creativity, craftsmanship, and accountability.

  • Contribute to premium brand projects across a variety of industries.

  • Collaborate with experienced creative professionals.

  • Strengthen your ability to create compelling content across different visual styles.

  • Build a diverse portfolio of real-world branded content.

  • Gain exposure to modern creative tools, production systems, and AI-assisted workflows.

  • Grow into a key contributor within an expanding creative agency.

Important Notes

  • This is a remote/telecommute position.

  • Candidates must be based in Latin America.

  • Candidates must be available to work approximately 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Central Time.

  • This is primarily a video editing role. Motion graphics are an important complementary skill but are not the main focus of the position.

  • This is not a client-facing role.

  • This is not a video-shooting role. The company provides the footage to be edited.

  • This is not a senior motion design, character animation, illustration-led, or 3D generalist position.

  • The creative leadership team will define the overall creative direction, and the selected candidate will be responsible for executing and extending that direction.

  • A professional portfolio or reel is required as part of the application.

  • The portfolio should demonstrate real-footage social media content, strong editing pace, color work, sound selection, motion graphics, and the ability to work across different brand identities.

  • Portfolios focused exclusively on character animation, 3D rendering, illustration, or a small number of cinematic films may not demonstrate the experience required for this role.

  • Candidates must provide their own professional equipment, including a computer capable of running Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, AI tools, and handling 4K footage efficiently.

  • Candidates must have fast and reliable internet suitable for uploading, downloading, and reviewing large video files.

raw.description:
Who is Credible?

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

About the Role:

Credible is looking for an AI-native Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our student loan lending marketplace, our flagship product. You will own and deliver features from ideation through launch, in close collaboration with design, engineering, and data. Primarily, you'll focus on the front-end experience that helps students and parents discover and compare options across multiple lenders.

This role requires AI fluency in both how you work and what you build. In your workflow, you bring working concepts rather than documents describing them, using AI tools like Claude to prototype ideas, run your own analysis, and validate concepts before committing engineering resources. You bring the experience and rigor to know which few ideas are worth building, and the drive to see them through.

In the product itself, you will shape how Credible reaches users as loan discovery moves beyond the comparison page and into AI assistants and embedded experiences, and you will determine where AI belongs within our own funnel to make comparing and choosing a loan simpler. Where AI touches the product, you own the quality bar: defining what good output looks like, measuring it, and ensuring it stays accurate and compliant.

Teams will look to you and your product leadership to guide the product's vision and direction and to achieve team OKRs.

Responsibilities:

  • Think Strategically and Creatively: Deliver new features for growing the student loan marketplace and align them with Credible's long-term vision. Synthesize market trends, regulatory shifts in the student loan space, user needs, and rapidly advancing AI capabilities to continually reinvent the platform, including how it reaches users beyond our own site.
  • Own AI-Powered Product Surfaces: Shape how Credible helps students and parents discover and choose loans through AI assistants, embedded experiences, and AI-assisted flows within our own funnel. Decide where AI meaningfully improves the experience and where it doesn't belong.
  • Own the Roadmap: Manage roadmaps for both private student loans and student loan refinance products by identifying opportunities, weighing tradeoffs, and prioritizing team resources. Decide not only what to build, but what to remove when it isn't earning its place.
  • Prototype and Validate: Use AI tools like Claude to build working concepts, test them quickly, and validate ideas with real artifacts. Explore many approaches, and find the ones that resonate with users and lenders.
  • Make Data-Driven Decisions: Utilize data analysis, A/B testing, and user research to validate assumptions, uncover insights, and drive meaningful improvements to the business. Run your own queries and analysis rather than depending on others for every question.
  • Lead and Collaborate Across Functions: Proactively engage cross-functional teams to brainstorm innovative solutions and lead their implementation. Collaborate with engineering, design, data, partnerships, and operations teams to deliver product enhancements and achieve team OKRs.
  • Operate Responsibly in a Regulated Space: Student lending is compliance-constrained. Understand where AI-assisted work and AI-generated output need human review, where claims and disclosures matter, and how to move fast without creating regulatory or trust risk.

Education and Experience:

  • At least 4 years of experience in a Product Management role for web-based consumer Internet products
  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Deep, demonstrated fluency using AI tools in your actual workflow for prototyping, analysis, research synthesis, and writing, with a clear point of view on where they help and where they don't
  • Genuine interest in and ideas about building AI-powered product experiences, not just using AI to work faster
  • Ability to bring working concepts to life, whether through AI tooling, light coding, or strong partnership with engineering
  • Familiarity with how to evaluate AI output quality, or clear aptitude and appetite to own it
  • Ability to use data, your experience, and product instincts to identify the most impactful areas of focus, including running your own analysis
  • Strong analytical abilities across spreadsheets, SQL, and other analytics tools
  • Exceptional problem-solving and communication skills
  • Strong project management skills, and willingness/ability to own critical parts of the product, end-to-end
  • Thrive on collaboration with other teams to accomplish shared goals
  • Technical aptitude sufficient to work closely with engineers, evaluate implementation approaches, and weigh cost/benefit tradeoffs
  • A bias toward experimentation and the discipline to walk away from your own ideas when the evidence says so

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay ranges for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location, are listed below. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents.

View more details about Credible Benefits

Why work at Credible?

We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we’re the friend you always wish you had in finance.

We are optimistic, challengers, trustworthy, clever, and smart. We are open and transparent. We strive to act as advisors by being friendly, objective, and open in our communication. We use language that is intelligent yet approachable. When appropriate, we’ll drop in a bit of wit to position ourselves as a fresh, reliable voice in the financial world.

Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The role partners closely with business stakeholders, security architects, and engineering teams to translate strategic objectives into pragmatic, scalable, and cost-effective cloud architectures aligned with enterprise standards.
